fee_notes: Standard fee is $30,000 (lump sum, non-refundable). Reduced to $15,000 for Sponsorship Program participants (payable via Sponsorship Note). Waived for Purchase Agreement franchisees. Veterans receive $10,000 reduction. Area Development Agreement fees: 1st FA $30,000, 2nd-5th $20,000, 6th+ $15,000.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee for any Toppers Pizza restaurant you agree to open under a Franchise Agreement entered into other than pursuant to an Area Development Agreement or a Purchase Agreement is $30,000.
